note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1958: 28 nominations for the 30 seats other than Clady, the only contest; the retiring members for Corporation West and Tullyroan were deemed re-elected. Polled 5 June 1958; a 94 per cent poll with one spoilt vote. Kilpatrick was the official Unionist candidate in succession to James Marshall. The nomination list prints McArdle as "Hugh F."
